description: This file defines the class `assignment_mgr`, which manages assignment activities related to test case assignments, user assignments, and associated database operations within the TestLink testing management system. It includes methods for retrieving assignment types and statuses, deleting assignments by various criteria, copying assignments between builds, counting assignments, and sending notification emails.

classes.name: assignment_mgr
classes.description: A class managing assignment activities for test case and user assignments, including CRUD operations, copying, counting, and notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with a database connection.

methods.name: get_available_types
methods.description: Retrieve available assignment types, optionally keyed by a specified field.

methods.name: get_available_status
methods.description: Retrieve available assignment statuses, keyed by a specified field.

methods.name: delete_by_feature_id
methods.description: Delete assignments associated with specific feature IDs.

methods.name: delete_by_build_id
methods.description: Delete user assignments associated with a specific build ID, with optional deletion of all types or only testers.

methods.name: delete_by_feature_id_and_build_id
methods.description: Delete assignments for specific feature IDs and a build ID.

methods.name: deleteBySignature
methods.description: Delete assignments matching specific signatures (feature, build, user, etc.).

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assign users to features with specific types and statuses; checks for existing assignments before inserting.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update existing assignments based on feature IDs and provided field data.

methods.name: get_count_of_assignments_for_build_id
methods.description: Count total assignments for a given build ID, optionally filtering by user and type.

methods.name: get_not_run_tc_count_per_build
methods.description: Count the number of assigned test cases that have not been run for a given build, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: copy_assignments
methods.description: Copy assignments from one build to another, optionally keeping old assignments or copying all types.

methods.name: getExecAssignmentsCountByBuild
methods.description: Retrieve counts of test case execution assignments per build.

methods.name: getNotRunAssignmentsCountByBuild
methods.description: Retrieve counts of assignments that are not yet executed per build.

methods.name: getUsersByFeatureBuild
methods.description: Retrieve a map of user IDs assigned to specific features within a build and of a certain assignment type.

methods.name: emailLinkToExecPlanning
methods.description: Send email links to users involved in specific test plans and builds, including project and plan details.
